name: CF PharmTech, Inc.
summary: CF PharmTech, Inc. researches, develops, produces and sells respiratory drugs and related medical products in China. Its products include Shufeimin, an azelastine and fluticasone nasal spray, ChangQi, a budesonide inhalation suspension, ChangShu, a salbutamol sulfate inhalation solution, and devices such as a piezoelectric mesh nebulizer and nasal cleansing fluids.
